:::{#def-binary-erasure-channel}
#### Binary erasure channel

The **binary erasure channel** with *erasure probability* $\alpha \in [0, 1]$
is the [discrete memoryless channel](#def-channel)
with $\mathcal{X} = \{0, 1\}$ and $\mathcal{Y} = \{0, \mathrm{e}, 1\}$
that delivers its input with probability $1 - \alpha$
and otherwise outputs the erasure symbol $\mathrm{e}$:

$$
p(y \mid x) =
\begin{cases}
1 - \alpha & \text{if } y = x, \\
\alpha & \text{if } y = \mathrm{e}, \\
0 & \text{otherwise}.
\end{cases}
$$

:::
